Master switch for electron-positron annihilation, e+ e- -> gamma gamma (am3_mojo addition), with Svensson's (1982)
exact rates and photon spectra. This process is not the photon-photon annihilation into pairs of
`set_process_annihilation`. Needs `set_process_merge_positrons_into_electrons(False)` (the default). A step's sinks

set_process_triplet_pair_production(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for triplet pair production, e+- gamma -> e+- e+ e- (am3_mojo addition). The process uses the
lowest-order QED matrix element (all eight diagrams), for ultra-relativistic leptons on photons below m_e c^2.

component `get_pairs_triplet`, and the photons are absorbed.
Set it before `init_kernels`: switched on after an `init_kernels` without it, it stays inactive.
Set to False (no triplet pair production, as in AM3) / True (pair emission and e+/- loss, each with its own switch). Default: True.

set_process_kaons

set_process_kaons(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for kaons (am3_mojo addition): K+-, K0_S and K0_L from photo-hadronic interactions of
protons and neutrons and from pp collisions. The switch also controls the escape, the cooling (synchrotron and
inverse Compton for K+-) and the decay of these kaons. It also controls their decay products (pions, muons, e+-,
neutrinos). Needs the photo-pion or the pp process with its emission. With kaons on, the pion yields of the
photo-hadronic multi-pion types are reduced by the kaons' energy. In pp collisions, the protons also lose the
kaons' energy. The kaons of charm decays come with the charm hadrons (set_process_charm), whatever the value of
this switch.
Set it before `init_kernels`: switched on after an `init_kernels` without it, it stays inactive.
Set to False (no kaons, as in AM3) / True. Default: True.

set_process_charm

set_process_charm(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for charm hadrons (am3_mojo addition): D+-, D0, anti-D0, Ds+-, Lambda_c+ and
anti-Lambda_c- from photo-hadronic interactions of protons and neutrons and from pp collisions. The switch
also controls the escape, the cooling (synchrotron and inverse Compton for the charged ones) and the decay of
these hadrons. It also controls their decay products (kaons, pions, muons, e+-, nucleons, photons, neutrinos and tau
neutrinos). Needs the photo-pion or the pp process with its emission. With charm on, the pion yields of the
photo-hadronic multi-pion types are reduced by the charm hadrons' energy. In pp collisions, the protons also
lose this energy.
Set it before `init_kernels`: switched on after an `init_kernels` without it, it stays inactive.
Set to False (no charm hadrons, as in AM3) / True. Default: True.

set_process_charm_decay

set_process_charm_decay(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Switch for charm decay (am3_mojo addition): every mode of D+-, D0, anti-D0, Ds+-, Lambda_c+ and
anti-Lambda_c- with a branching ratio above 0.5 % (PDG 2026). Charm decay also includes every exclusive
semileptonic mode above 0.1 %. The short-lived products of the charm decays (tau, eta, eta', omega, phi, rho,
K*, f0, a1, hyperons) decay at once.
Set to False (charm hadrons do not decay) / True. Default: True.
